# RedStream™ Premium Streaming

> RedStream is a premium 4K streaming service providing over 20,000 live international TV channels, 60,000 VOD movies and series, 99.9% server uptime, anti-freeze technology, and 24/7 customer support.

- [Full Technical Specification & Documentation](https://www.red-stream.store/llms-full.txt): Complete technical guide, device configurations, network benchmarks, and plans for AI agents.

## Streaming Features & Specifications

- [Anti-Freeze Technology](https://www.red-stream.store/#features): Dedicated server clusters with 99.9% uptime and zero buffering.
- [Live Sports & PPV](https://www.red-stream.store/#channels): Premium 4K sports channels covering Champions League, Premier League, UFC, and NBA.
- [Movies & VOD Library](https://www.red-stream.store/#vod): Over 60,000 on-demand blockbuster movies and trending series in Ultra HD.
